subject: general
question: Before the constitution of India, an “Objectives Resolution” was proposed by ______ in 1946.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru proposed the "Objectives Resolution" on 13th December 1946.
 
• The resolution outlined the aims and objectives of the Constituent Assembly and laid down the philosophy and ideals for the Constitution of India.
 
• The Objectives Resolution was unanimously adopted by the Constituent Assembly on 22nd January 1947.
 
• This resolution later became the preamble of the Indian Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Constituent Assembly**

 
 
• The Constituent Assembly of India was set up to draft the Constitution of India.
 
• The assembly was established in 1946 and consisted of representatives from various regions and communities of India.
 
• Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected as the President of the Constituent Assembly.
 
 
 
• **Objectives Resolution**
 
 
• The Objectives Resolution was a resolution adopted by the Constituent Assembly of India on 22nd January 1947.
 
• The resolution was proposed by Jawaharlal Nehru on 13th December 1946.
 
• It outlined the fundamental principles and philosophy on which the Indian Constitution was to be based.
 
• The resolution declared India as a sovereign, democratic republic and guaranteed its citizens justice, equality, and freedom.
 
 
 
• **Preamble of the Indian Constitution**
 
 
• The preamble is an introductory statement in the Constitution that outlines the guiding principles and philosophy of the document.
 
• It declares India to be a sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic.
 
• The preamble highlights the objectives of the Constitution, which include justice, liberty, equality, and fraternity for all citizens.
 
• The wording of the preamble is based on the Objectives Resolution proposed by Jawaharlal Nehru.
